name: Conjure
tagline: Turns a sentence into a walkable 3D interior through a pipeline of coordinated agents.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: People can describe a space but few can model it in 3D.
solution: A staged agent pipeline on Fetch.ai Agentverse plans rooms, lighting and furniture into a shared world spec, builds in parallel, validates, and streams progress to a React Three Fiber scene that stays editable.
demo_moment: Team-described: type a cabin prompt and walk through the result in the browser while watching agents work.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” among 307 submissions.
Shows the agents' work live instead of a black box.

lessons: Make the agents' progress visible; it turns waiting into part of the demo.
